mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Apply BQSR and quantize: input is a pre-BQSR alignment plus its recalibration table. Apply BQSR only: same input, no quantization. Quantize only: input is an existing alignment, with no BQSR applied; see Alignment Source.

applybqsr_gpus.title: GPUs for applying BQSR
applybqsr_gpus.description: 1 or 2. Recommended: 2 for 60x and deeper coverage (about 20% faster, slightly cheaper); 1 for shallower samples.

applybqsr_gpus.title: GPUs for applying BQSR
applybqsr_gpus.description: 1 or 2. Recommended: 2 for 60x and deeper coverage (about 20% faster, slightly cheaper); 1 for shallower samples.

alignment_source.title: Alignment Source
alignment_source.description: Which alignment in the input dataset to quantize. recalibrated: preprocessing/recalibrated (BQSR already applied, not quantized). markduplicates: the raw aligned, duplicate-marked alignment, with no BQSR applied (use when the reads were already recalibrated in the original BAM). auto: recalibrated when a sample has one, otherwise markduplicates.

genome_source.title: Reference Genome Source
genome_source.description: iGenomes GATK.GRCh38, or a custom genome from a Cirro BWA index dataset. Must match the reference the alignments were made with.

genome_index.title: BWA Genome Index
genome_index.description: The BWA genome index dataset the alignments were made with, containing genome.fasta and genome.fasta.fai.

output_fmt.title: Output Format
output_fmt.description: Format of the published alignment. CRAM is smaller.

cram_version.title: CRAM Version
cram_version.description: 3.0 is readable by essentially all tools; 3.1 is smaller but some tools (and coverage QC, which is skipped) cannot read it.

quantization.title: Quality-Score Quantization Options

preserve_qscores_less_than.title: Preserve Quality Scores Below
preserve_qscores_less_than.description: Quality scores below this value remain unchanged (GATK --preserve-qscores-less-than). Must be below the smallest bin.

round_down_quantized.title: Round Down
round_down_quantized.description: Round down to the largest bin at or below each score, instead of the nearest bin in probability space.

quantization.description: Collapses base qualities into a few bins to shrink the output; see the README lookup table for how scores map. Used by the modes that quantize; ignored by Apply BQSR Only.
